name: ai-enabler-kpi
displayName: AI Enabler KPI — AI usage measurement
description: Measures how a team delivers and how it uses AI. Passive, opt-in hooks capture AI usage: human interaction, AI working time versus human waiting and thinking time, output, and token cost in USD per session, user, ticket, skill and model (Anthropic or Amazon Bedrock prices). Delivery-flow skills measure pull request size, review waiting time, rework and Jira cycle time with bundled scripts, reading GitHub through the GitHub CLI. Everything is reported as self-contained HTML with charts, including per-developer figures, plus Markdown, JSON and CSV.
